name: librashader
role: Apply RetroArch slang shader presets (CRT, scanline) to images headlessly
notes: 2026-11-27: Lead from prospects/inbox/2026-11-20-discovery.md. Lead differed: crate licence is MPL-2.0 OR GPL-3.0-only (not MPL-2.0 alone); the CLI's file-path PNG output works; only the metal and wgpu runtimes exist on macOS, and wgpu failed.

2026-11-27: Install is cargo only, no Homebrew formula; crate declares no rust-version, rustc 1.95.0 built it. Default features need cmake for OpenGL glfw; built with --no-default-features --features metal,wgpu into the example's ignored output/cargo.
2026-11-27: Presets and shaders are separate, each with its own licence (crt-lottes public domain, crt-geom GPL-2.0-or-later); libretro/slang-shaders has no single licence.

evidence.result: crt-lottes on 3 generated 320x240 frames to 960x720 via Metal: curvature, scanlines, mask seen; shuffled order and rerun byte-identical. wgpu runtime KNOWN FAIL: PIPELINE_CACHE unsupported.
evidence.scope: Metal runtime, macOS arm64 M3; crt-lottes (PD) and crt-geom single-pass presets; per-frame calls. wgpu fails; no OpenGL/Vulkan, multi-pass or temporal presets.

summary: Runs RetroArch slang shader presets (CRT, scanline, NTSC, handheld LCD looks) on an image from the command line and writes a PNG for a chosen frame number. Presets come from separate repositories with per-shader licences.
use_when: Give a still or generated frame an accurate CRT or retro display look from the libretro slang-shaders library
Render a shader preset for a given frame number outside an emulator
avoid_when: Need a single GLSL shader run or live editing: glslviewer
Need GPU video processing hooks or tone mapping: libplacebo
Need a filter chain from another plugin family: frei0r or g-mic
license: MPL-2.0 OR GPL-3.0-only (librashader-cli); slang presets carry their own licences, per shader

assessment.rationale: Documented CLI render command applies a preset to an image for a given frame; no catalogued neighbour runs the slang preset library. Licence is free for the CLI, shaders must be checked individually.
